name: spear-bootstrap-probe-lifecycle
description: Spear startup repair (PR #195), the sorcerer summon probe's ownership of fixture state. Launch 1 holds the probe (test-only stallAfter=party) after it has spawned the new sorcerer and added it to the party, so the step times out; the harness must release everything through the probe slot, count only that timeout as the expected outcome, and a later residue step must find no sorcerer in the area or the party and no ability in the targeting handler. Launch 2 runs the probe to completion with a test-only release action that throws after every real release; the step must fail, isolation must be reported unrestored, the launch must stop before its next step, and the harness verdict must fail.
